sloka: युवाभ्याम् स हि धर्मात्मा सुग्रीवः सख्यम् इच्छति ।तस्य माम् सचिवम् वित्तम् वानरम् पवनात्मजम् ॥४-३-२२॥
transliteration: yuvābhyām sa hi dharmātmā sugrīvaḥ sakhyam icchati ।tasya mām sacivam vittam vānaram pavanātmajam ॥4-3-22॥

translations.english: 'The righteous Sugriva wishes to make friendship with both of you. For his wellbeing I came here disguised as a mendicant from Rishyamuka mountain. I am a monkey, son of the Windgod and minister to Sugriva. I can assume any form at my free will and go anywhere I like'.
